# gravitino_models Data Source

Lists all models within a Gravitino metalake, catalog, and schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_models" "example" {
  metalake = "example_metalake"
  catalog  = "ml_catalog"
  schema   = "example_schema"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The catalog name.
- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `schema` (String) The schema name.

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) List of models with their details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models--audit))
- `comment` (String) The model comment.
- `latest_version` (Number) The latest version number of the model.
- `name` (String) The model name.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value properties for the model.

<a id="nestedatt--models--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models.audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String)
- `creator` (String)
- `last_modified_time` (String)
- `last_modifier` (String)
